verdict.rationale: An online company-incorporation service publishes web guidance, so offering llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for it. The evidence pack only covers human-facing service-page content (entity types, authentication methods, fees, steps) and never mentions llms.txt, machine-readable docs, or agent-oriented documentation.
